This all looks correct. The implementation is complete:

- **`src/config/constants.ts`** — added `MAX_SUB_ISSUE_DEPTH`.
- **`src/lib/issue-hierarchy.ts`** (new) — `IssueHierarchyError`.
- **`src/lib/errors.ts`** — recognizes and maps `IssueHierarchyError` to `conflict`.
- **`src/types/issue.ts`** — added `IssueRollup`.
- **`src/schemas/issue.ts`** — added `setIssueParentSchema`/`SetIssueParentInput`.
- **`src/types/notification.ts`**, **`src/schemas/notification.ts`**, **`src/server/db/schema/notifications.ts`**, **`notification-preferences-form.tsx`** — added the `sub_issues_completed` kind everywhere it's enumerated.
- **`src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts`** — `listChildIssues`, `listDescendants` (full-tree traversal for cycle/depth/cascade), `setIssueParent`, and an id-overridable `insertIssue`.
- **`src/server/services/issue-service.ts`** — parent validation at creation, cascading `archiveIssue`, new `setIssueParent`/`listSubIssues`/`getIssueRollup`, and private `levelOf`/`assertNoCycle`/`maxRelativeDepth` helpers enforcing the cycle and depth rules.
- **`src/server/services/notification-service.ts`** — new subscribers on `issue.status_changed`/`issue.archived` implementing the `sub_issues_completed` completion notice, scoped to the direct parent only, deduplicated by construction (only a cascade's root issue can have a live parent outside the cascade).
- **`tests/services/issue-hierarchy.test.ts`** (new) — 24 tests covering placement/move, cycle and depth guards, listing, roll-up, cascade archiving, and the completion notice's edge cases.

Full suite (641 tests), `tsc --noEmit`, and `eslint` all pass clean.
